subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a one-line summary, and the requested behavior adds a new public config/lifecycle contract rather than repairing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept scoped default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option with checklist rendering while leaving the current collapse-summary behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep the one-line summary
options.body: Decline full draft persistence for now and treat the current compact post-turn summary as the supported Telegram progress finalization behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track full checklist persistence as a broader cross-channel progress-card API instead of adding a Telegram-only config key now.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option with checklist rendering while leaving the current collapse-summary behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the merged PR that introduced the current Telegram summary lifecycle and focused tests this decision would extend.
